result:
I played all 24 months. All three training runs finished on time, inference demand was fully served every month, and the final **net cost is $1,274.2M** with no penalties.

| Window | Done / needed (kH-months) |
|---|---|
| Months 0–7 | 84.9 / 60 |
| Months 8–15 | 250.8 / 140 |
| Months 16–23 | about 350 / 320 (306.2 done going into the last month, with about 42 to spare) |

**Settlement ($M):** spend 1,643.2, minus 520.1 for GPUs still held at month 24, plus 151.1 of power and contract obligations past month 23. Spend broke down as capex 1,360, power 215.4, cloud contracts 194.8, spot 5.2, unserved inference 0, and resale income −132.2.

**How it went:**
- **Months 0–7:** I bought 20k gen H GPUs and signed 48 MW of power straight away, while supply was loose. Inference demand turned out to grow about 7% a month, roughly 6 kH at the start to 30 kH by the end.
- **Months 5–11:** supply turned tight and stayed tight for most of the game. I bought 12k more H, made the first cloud reservation (3 kH for 24 months at $1.26M), and signed 28 MW more power. That power started in month 15, before the original 16 MW contract ended at month 19.
- **Month 12:** gen N launched, as the vendor had confirmed a month earlier. Gen H was discontinued, but the H I had already ordered still shipped. I ordered 14k gen N, and over months 12–14 I added two 12-month cloud reservations of 3 kH each to cover the last window.
- **Months 20–23:** gen N arrived at about 1.5k a month and took power first, which left some H unpowered. I resold the idle H, then in the last month sold 3k H and 3k N while their resale value was still above the month-24 mark.

**What cost the most:**
- **Surplus in months 8–15:** I delivered nearly double the 140 kH-months that window needed. That compute counts for nothing; the extra H was bought for the final window, and buying it early avoided the tight supply, the export controls and the H discontinuation.
- **Power and contracts running past month 23:** they added $151M at settlement. The 28 MW signed in month 9 alone runs to month 38.
- **Spare capacity at the end:** the last window finished about 30 kH-months over, so I probably bought somewhat more gen N or reservations than needed.
